name: Cerebras Systems
description: Cerebras makes a wafer-scale AI processor, a single chip the size of a whole silicon wafer, and sells AI speed built on it. It sells in two ways: AI systems for customers to run in their own data centers (hardware), and compute capacity it runs itself (cloud and other services), mostly fast inference on dedicated take-or-pay capacity or pay-per-token. The business is mid-pivot from hardware to cloud: in Q2 2026 cloud and other services were 70% of revenue versus 32% a year earlier, driven by a December 2025 master agreement under which OpenAI committed to 750 MW of inference capacity deployed in tranches over 2026 to 2028. Remaining performance obligations were $25.4 billion at June 30, 2026, against H1 2026 revenue of $373.5 million, and customer concentration is extreme (an Abu Dhabi university, MBZUAI, was 49% of H1 2026 revenue).

hq.note: Corporate headquarters, about 68,000 sq ft leased (May 14, 2026 prospectus); EDGAR business address 1237 E. Arques Ave., Sunnyvale

employees.note: 426 in the United States, the rest mainly in Canada and India (May 14, 2026 prospectus)

businessLines.name: Hardware
businessLines.how: One-time sale of a system on delivery or acceptance, with the revenue reduced from Q1 2026 by non-cash amortization of warrants issued to customers.
businessLines.description: Sales of Cerebras AI systems (wafer-scale engine supercomputers) and related equipment for on-premises training and inference.

businessLines.name: Cloud and other services
businessLines.how: Dedicated Capacity is take-or-pay: the customer pays for reserved compute whether or not it uses it, recognized over the contract term; On-Demand is pay-per-token or prepaid token bundles; support contracts run one to five years and are recognized ratably; pass-through data-center costs are billed at cost.
businessLines.description: Cerebras Cloud: Dedicated Capacity and On-Demand inference and training; support and operation of customers' on-premises clusters; AI modeling services; plus pass-through data-center costs billed to specific customers.

brands.name: Cerebras Cloud
brands.share: Cloud and other services were 70.0% of Q2 2026 revenue; Cerebras Cloud is not split from partner-cloud and support revenue

brands.name: Wafer-scale engine AI systems (CS systems)
brands.share: Hardware was 30.0% of Q2 2026 revenue and 70.3% of FY2025 revenue (derived)
